quote: Amendment No. 1 § 2.1 (replacing Supply Agreement § 11.2) ... Supplier's indemnity (§ 9.1) | All of § 9.1 | Only § 9.1(c) (IP claims) | Recall costs (§ 10) | Yes | **Removed** ... if a product defect causes a recall costing $20 million, or a defective bottle causes personal injury giving rise to a third-party claim, Harrowgate's recovery is now capped at the fees paid in the six months before the claim arose (Supply Agreement § 11.1)
reason: The memo identifies the provision of Amendment No. 1 that replaces Supply Agreement § 11.2. It cites it as § 2.1 rather than Section 2, which is a minor numbering difference. It states that recall costs are removed from the carve-outs and that the indemnity carve-out is limited to IP claims under § 9.1(c). It also explains that recall and product-liability exposure is now capped at six months of fees, and it recommends restoring the original § 11.2.
